tools.name: check_context_cliff
tools.description: Check one LLM request's token counts against a pricing snapshot and return a deterministic decision: allow, pre-cliff warning, hard-cliff reroute, or budget-gate block, with estimated costs and a cheaper fallback model where one exists. Estimates only, not billing. Receives model name and token coun

tools.name: list_supported_models
tools.description: Return the 5 deterministic cliff-engine models supported by check_context_cliff along with their input/output rates, cache rates, cliff token thresholds, soft-block thresholds, fallback targets, pricing_snapshot_id, and Merkle root.

tools.name: etuki_search_models
tools.description: Search and filter across all 563 Merkle-committed LLM API and cloud infrastructure entities in the Etuki catalog by keyword.

tools.name: etuki_get_audit_evidence
tools.description: Retrieve the cryptographic snapshot metadata (Merkle root, RS256 public key URL, snapshot date, and 12/12 CI self-test reference) for the current pricing snapshot.

findings.title: Description uses pressure/override language
findings.detail: Description of "check_context_cliff" stacks urgency/override words (never, warning). Legitimate tool descriptions rarely pressure the model to act or ignore prior guidance.
